releaseNotes: 🧮 Loan Insurance Calculator: Added MRTT / MRTA (age 25–50) and Houseowner / Fire Insurance calculations with option to finance into loan or pay cash upfront.
🔄 Seamless Navigation: Floating bottom navigation bar automatically restores when using Android back gesture from listings.
📐 Bottom Screen Clearance: Fixed tab screen padding so all case action buttons and follow-up rows remain unobstructed.
✨ Instant Listing Sync: Creating a property now auto-refreshes Listings, scrolls to the top, and displays a success toast.
💬 Technical Support Update: Converted WhatsApp technical support to a dedicated Coming Soon status badge.
